While pure OpenCV pipelines are highly effective for extracting clean SVG outlines from high-contrast setups, chaotic real-world desks with varying depths of field require a shift in architecture.

    • Geometric Plausibility: Aspect ratio, rectangularity, and edge straightness.
    • Content Density: Does the polygon contain high-frequency noise (ink)?
